content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

Stripe and PayPal promise convenience but deliver dependency. They control your payment flow, hold your funds, and can suspend your account without notice. In contrast, sovereign stacks like COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit ($197) hand you full ownership. You deploy on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and store orders in Supabase or Google Sheets. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a flat 0.5% fee and no KYC. File delivery is handled through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The tradeoff? You manage your stack. The reward? No platform can shut you down.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal restrict access based on geography, leaving creators in Ghana stranded. Sovereign infrastructure ignores borders. Cloudflare’s global edge network ensures your store loads fast for buyers anywhere. NOWPayments accepts payments from any wallet, on any blockchain, without requiring buyer accounts. Your store runs on GitHub or Cloudflare—platforms that don’t care where you’re located. This isn’t a workaround; it’s base-layer architecture designed for creators in regions Stripe abandoned. You’re not circumventing restrictions—you’re operating outside their reach entirely.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe charges 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction and holds funds for days. PayPal is worse: up to 4.5% for international payments, plus currency conversion fees. NOWPayments charges 0.5% and settles payments on-chain instantly. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. The real cost? Stripe’s hidden expense is dependency. With a sovereign stack, your only recurring cost is the blockchain fee. No monthly subscriptions, no revenue share, no platform lock-in. You pay for what you use—nothing more.
Sovereign infrastructure removes geographic barriers entirely—no workarounds required.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Stripe and PayPal own your payment data. With a sovereign stack, your data lives in your Supabase database or Google Sheet. Orders trigger automatic file delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Once deployed, COREMERCH has no access to your infrastructure. You own the code, the hosting, and the payment flow. Automation is built into the stack: payment confirmation fires a webhook that delivers the product instantly. This isn’t SaaS—it’s infrastructure you control. If Cloudflare or GitHub goes down, your store stays up because it’s distributed across their global networks.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re selling digital products in Ghana and need immediate payment processing without geographic restrictions, a sovereign stack is the only option. Stripe and PayPal are non-starters. COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit gives you all blueprints and templates to deploy in hours. Start with the Edge Commerce Stack if you’re scaling; use the Sovereign Starter Stack if you’re launching your first product. The tradeoff is clear: you exchange convenience for control. But for creators in restricted regions, control isn’t a luxury—it’s survival. Choose architecture that respects your sovereignty, not platforms that exploit your geography.

The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete answer — Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments deployed under your accounts in 48 hours. Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack for simplicity or Edge Commerce Stack for scalability. 2. Deploy hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 3. Set up backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 4. Configure order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets. 5. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. 6. Set up file delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 7. Test end-to-end: payment confirmation should trigger instant product delivery. 8. Load your products and launch your store. 9. Monitor transactions in your Supabase dashboard or Google Sheet. 10. Scale using the included playbook for high-volume orders.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not technical?

Yes. COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit includes step-by-step guides and templates. You don’t need to write code from scratch—just follow the deployment instructions. The stack is designed for creators, not developers.
What if I want to accept fiat currency?

The stack is designed for crypto payments, but you can add fiat options via third-party gateways that support your region. However, crypto eliminates currency conversion fees and geographic restrictions.
How do I handle refunds?
Refunds are processed manually by sending crypto back to the buyer’s wallet. Since you own the payment flow, you control refund policies without platform interference.
What happens if Cloudflare or GitHub goes down?
Your store remains operational because it’s distributed across their global networks. Even if one region fails, your site stays up. This is the advantage of using enterprise-grade infrastructure.
Is there ongoing support after deployment?
The Complete Builder Kit includes 30 days of support. After that, you own and manage the stack. The documentation and community resources are available for troubleshooting.
